summary: The plan accurately represents the user's request: it adds a per-session static QR/URL switch, preserves SUN-only behavior when off, allows mixed SUN and static URL tagging when on, and keeps hosted DB changes in a new migration. The two Todos are grounded in the request, split along reviewable DB/API and UI flow boundaries, and have objective acceptance criteria.
warnings: The plan makes MASTER default choices for request open questions, especially switch default OFF, no manual code entry, and no in-app NFC writing. These are reasonable defaults and are explicitly called out as overrideable, so they are not blockers.
evidence: Read request artifact `.ai/tasks/active/TASK-20260928-001/request.md`: explicit requirements are per-session fixed QR/static URL switch and mixed use with SUN in switch-on sessions; constraints preserve switch-off behavior and require new SQL only as a new migration.

Read plan artifact `.ai/tasks/active/TASK-20260928-001/plan.md`: goal and constraints match the request, with switch OFF preserving SUN-only behavior and switch ON allowing SUN plus static `/t/{token}` in the same session.

Read Todo artifacts `TODO-001.md` and `TODO-002.md`: TODO-001 covers migration, API, data contract, anti-cheat behavior, and switch-off preservation; TODO-002 covers admin switch UI, QR/static URL display, `/t/{token}`, `/race`, and README operator note.

Todo acceptance criteria are objectively reviewable, including switch-off rejection, mixed mode, no UID-only path, no token leaks, admin PATCH behavior, browser validation, and pending-tag flow checks.
regressions_checked: Plan excludes changes to SUN verification, counters, baseline, registration, ranking, ceremony, re-join, login limiting, and Realtime architecture.
Plan explicitly requires switch-off sessions to remain unchanged and static token submissions to write no events or team changes when off.
Plan requires participant-facing responses not to leak tag tokens, UIDs, or key material.
Plan requires existing applied migrations to remain byte-identical and new DB changes to be placed in exactly one new migration file.
